description: This file contains serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for the SortedList<TKey, TValue> type within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines a serializer class, a surrogate struct, and a deep copier class for SortedList, enabling custom serialization and deep copying of SortedList instances.

classes.name: SortedListCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer class for SortedList<TKey, TValue>, converting to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: SortedListSurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate data structure for serializing SortedList<TKey, TValue>.

classes.name: SortedListCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier class for creating deep copies of SortedList<TKey, TValue> instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a SortedList<TKey, TValue> instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedList<TKey, TValue> into its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SortedList<TKey, TValue>.
